reviews.name: Dilshan Karunaratne
reviews.message: The WhatsApp concierge made the whole order effortless for my mother’s birthday in Colombo 05. The roses arrived fresh, beautifully arranged, and lasted beautifully for over a week.

reviews.name: Ananya Perera
reviews.message: This flower studio feels premium and personal from start to finish. The lilies arrived smelling incredible and the handwritten card made the gift feel extra special.

reviews.name: Rukshan Fernando
reviews.message: We ordered a gourmet hamper for a graduation celebration and the delivery was perfectly on time. The packaging and presentation were elegant and very Sri Lankan in style.

reviews.name: Shanika Wijesinghe
reviews.message: I ordered from Melbourne for my sister’s anniversary and paid by card in minutes. They sent a photo of the bouquet before it left the studio, and it looked even better in person.

reviews.name: Faiz Mohamed
reviews.message: Lovely sunflowers and very friendly service. The order came about an hour later than I hoped, but they messaged me on WhatsApp to let me know, and the flowers were perfect.

reviews.name: Chamari Ratnayake
reviews.message: They handled the flowers for our Poruwa ceremony and the bridal bouquet. Everything matched the colours we chose and arrived at the hotel early in the morning, fresh and calm.
